The *Dutiyasīla Sutta* (Iti 33; PTS It 26) is a short discourse located in the second chapter (Dukanipāta) of the *Itivuttaka*. The text presents the brief doctrinal teaching that a person endowed with auspicious ethical conduct (*sīla*) and auspicious views (*diṭṭhi*) is destined for rebirth in heaven.
